Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this game. It's going all downhill for the Asian side and it would require something spectacular from them if they are to win at least a game in this series. New Zealand now can test their bench strength since they have already got the hands on the trophy. Will we see Pakistan managing a win or will the plot remain the same in Hamilton? Join us on 16th January, 2018 for the fourth ODI at 1400 Local (0100 GMT) to catch all the action. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson is elated with the show. Feels the surface was a bit tricky but still wasn't that bad to bat on. Adds Trent Boult has been fabulous throughout the series. At the halfway break, they had a talk that they have good amount of runs in the bank, it's all about bowling well and executing the plans. Is happy that his batters spent time in the middle and stitched valuable partnerships. Hopes to carry on the good show and informs their focus is to win each and every game.

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed is really disappointed with the loss. Adds this is a tough loss for them to gulp. Admits his bowlers did a fine job but their batting flopped again. Hopes to sort out the issue with the new ball and not lose too many wickets in the first ten overs.

Man of the Match, Trent Boult is really delighted with his performance but feels it was a collective effort on their part to win the game. Opines it was quite windy out there and he let the ball go as aggressively as he could. Adds they wanted to seal the series today and knew that 250 was always good to seal the fate.

Trent Boult was breathing fire with the new ball. He ran havoc at the top and then came back to pick up a 5-wicket haul. Tim Southee from the other end was very disciplined too while the rest just came and continued to chip away at the wickets to completely choke the visitors. The fact that the no. 11 is the highest scorer in the second innings should tell you how poor the batting was from the Asian side. If it wasn't for Amir and Raees' fun in the middle, their side would have faced even more embarrassment. Stay with us as we bring you the presentation...

A shambolic batting performance by Pakistan or deadly bowling display from the Kiwis? It's for you all to think about that. Yes, agreed that 258 was tough on this kind of a wicket but getting bundled out for a paltry 74 is not acceptable at all. Their batsmen never really came to the party and as a result they surrendered meekly to give New Zealand the series. The chase never took off as the visitors were reduced to 16/6 and it was all about saving the blushes from thereon.

OUT! And fittingly the one who started the rampage, ends it too. Trent Boult picks up his fourth 5-fer to end the Pakistan innings. A perfect yorker at a good pace which is too good for the no. 11. Raees misses and hears the death rattle. NZ WIN BY 183 RUNS.

FOUR! Fuller delivery on the stumps, Raees clears his front leg and thwacks it over mid on for another boundary. He's having some fun in the middle. Pakistan avoid the lowest ODI score in New Zealand now.

Good shot! Full toss on middle, punched down the ground past Southee who fails to stop it with his right boot in the followthrough. The man from long on dives to his left to cut it off, they take only a single.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Wide! Short and miles over the head of the Pakistan skipper. Left alone.
Indipping full toss on the pads, Raees looks to flick but gets it off the inner half through backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! That's off the meat! What a powerful stroke! Touch short on middle, it sits up at a good height. Raees clears his front leg and murders the swipe across the line over mid-wicket.
Bowls a leg cutter, at 104.7 kph, it comes back in as Raees pokes it out somehow.
Shortish delivery on middle, RR makes room and steers it by hopping in the crease towards point. Looks for the single but it is not on.
Fuller and on the pads, flicked neatly through backward square leg. Southee from fine leg does well to keep them down to two which means Raees will be on strike in the next over.
Wide! Bangs in a short one on middle and leg, it bounces way too much as Ahmed lets his opposite number collect it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes over the wicket and hurls a cutter on middle, Raees pushes it away to cover and Sarfraz calls him through for a single.
That wasn't away from the off pole! Fuller on the stumps, Raees clears his front leg to send it out of Dunedin but only manages to connect with thin air.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed with an angled bat to point.
Boult comes from around the wicket and angles in a fuller ball on the stumps, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Short stuff again from Southee, RR manages to steer it behind point to keep strike.
FOUR! Slashes and slashes hard! Short and outside off, Rumman Raees makes room to slap it but gets a top edge which flies over a leaping Latham for a boundary.

That's off the helmet! A bouncer on middle and off, it kicks off the surface to beat the attempted pull of Raees. He gets a blow on the helmet as the ball lobs in the air towards the off side. Looks fine though.
Shortish delivery outside off, glided down towards third man for a single.
Back of a length delivery on middle, tucked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Shortish on middle, swatted towards mid-wicket.
Rumman Raees is the last man in. Tim Southee is back on as well. Can he wrap things up in this over?

OUT! 4-fer for Trent Boult! He goes a touch wider of the crease and drops it on a length on middle. Seemed like Amir was expecting a bouncer and hence he stayed leg side of the ball. At the last moment he tries to defend it with a straight bat but gets an outside edge which disturbs the stumps.
FOUR! That's some way to go past the 50-run mark! Fuller ball on the stumps, Mohammad Amir clears his front leg and goes bang over Boult's head for a boundary.
Very full but the line is on the leg stump, MA digs it out towards short mid-wicket.
Hits the deck hard, but this one is at a comfortable height for Amir to keep it out towards cover.
Uses the pace and runs it down towards third man for a single.
Slants it away from over the wicket, slapped hard but finds the point fielder.
Here he comes, the wrecker-in-chief, Trent Boult back into the attack.
On middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Slower one, at 102.3 kph, Amir looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. No appeal made as it was sliding down leg.
Angling in on a length from outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Shortish and angling in on middle and off, Amir hangs back and pushes it back to Munro.
Slower delivery on the pads, flicked towards backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot towards extra cover.
FOUR! Flayed it through cover! Gets a fuller ball outside off, Amir drills it on the up. No need to run. Pakistan avoid their lowest ever total in the ODIs.
Shortish and angling away outside off, Amir takes his eyes off the ball to let it sail over him to Latham.
Another short ball on middle and off, MA hops to defend it down.
Shortish and slanting away outside off, tapped towards point.
Back of a length outside off, Sarfraz steers it down to third man for a single.
Very full on middle and off, Amir jams it out towards mid off. Williamson from extra cover moves across to his left but slips while attacking the ball. They take the single by then.
Short of a length ball outside off, Sarfraz hangs back and keeps it out.
Surprise delivery from Munro. A bouncer with the keeper standing up and Ahmed ducks under it.
Overpitched outside off, Amir goes for a drive but outside edges it towards third man for a run.
Full length ball on middle and leg, driven nicely through mid on for a run.
Fullish delivery around off, Sarfraz crouches and tucks it with a closed bat face to mid-wicket.
Angling in substantially, clipped to the man at short mid-wicket.
Stays rooted to the crease and plays this one defensively to mid-wicket.
Full length ball on leg stump, chipped towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! So close to getting another wicket! Back of a length ball, slanting across Amir. He pushes at it tentatively and gets a thick outside edge past the stumps. Goes past the keeper and through to the fine leg fence.
Wide! Ferguson bends his back and bangs this one hard. It is outside off which allows Amir to make an easy leave. Wide signaled for height.
Short of a length ball around off, pushed off the back foot to the off side.
Overpitched on off, Amir presses forward and eases it to covers.
Short of a length on middle, tucked around the corner for a single.
Fuller in length, driven crisply off the front foot to the off side.
On a length outside off, pushed with an open bat face to point.
Sits deep in the crease and punches this one to covers.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
On a length, angling in, Amir keeps it out gingerly.
Mohammad Amir walks out to the middle.

OUT! Was that a bird? Was that a plane? No, it was the Kiwi skipper. What an amazing catch. No matter how many times you see the replays, you will always stand up and admire. Shortish ball on off, Ali pulls it towards short mid-wicket but mistimes it a bit. Williamson stationed there is really alert. Lines it up and dives full length to his right to grab a one-handed stunner. He managed to hang onto that with his fingertips. He is down on the ground and has a big smile on his face. Munro runs across to him and lifts him in his arms. Jubilation for New Zealand while dejection for Pakistan.
On a length outside off, Hasan goes hard at it and edges it towards third man for a single.
Wide! Another short ball but this one is too high. Ali sits under it.
Short delivery, Ali sits under it.
Hasan Ali is the new man in.

OUT! Ferguson joins the party as well! A case of another batsman throwing his wicket away. Short delivery on off, angling across Ashraf. He goes for a full-fledged pull, aiming to pull it on the roof once again but this time his head position is nowhere. Ends up getting a top edge that skies towards fine leg. Todd Astle is cool as a cucumber and takes a fine reverse cup catch. The way Pakistan are playing, there is a strong feeling that they will get bundled out under 50.
Fraction straight this time and fullish in length, Faheem clips it nicely to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Pitched right up there on off, Ashraf leans ahead and pats it to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Ahmed places it through point for an easy run.
Time for Drinks.
Slower in pace, Sarfraz knocks it down to the same region for a single.
In the arc for Ashraf. He hits it hard to long on to rotate strike.
Fullish ball outside off, swinging in, defended down the track.
Fuller in length outside off, played with an open bat face towards point.
On a length again, blocked solidly.
Hangs back to the length ball and blocks it.
Very full outside off, jammed out.
The batsman plays the pull shot. One run added to the total.
Since the drizzle is picking up, the commentators on air reckon that Kane Williamson should bring Santner into the attack and get through the 20 overs quickly...
SIX! That came right off the screws! Short delivery, sits up nicely for Ashraf. He pulls it with aplomb over fine leg for a massive maximum. That went over the grand stand.
Short of a length ball, angling away, fended towards the point region.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Two Wides! Down the leg side, Ahmed misses the flick and the ball goes towards the keeper who fumbles. Two wides given but the replays show that the ball deflected off the pads.
Short of a length ball, takes off after pitching. Ahmed drops his wrists to let it through.
Fullish delivery, kept out watchfully.
Faheem Ashraf comes out to bat. It is also drizzling at the moment. Things are very gloomy for the visitors as well.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The visitors are committing suicide. With the side in deep trouble, it is difficult to fathom that kind of a shot. Reckless! Fullish delivery on off, Shadab Khan goes for an agricultural slog across the line but misses it completely to get the furniture shattered. This has been a dismal batting performance so far.
Good length ball, accurate line again. Khan hangs back and punches it to mid-wicket where it is nicely stopped.
Fuller in length, Khan presses forward and keeps it out.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Coming in with the angle, worked around the corner for a run.

So close! Follows up the bouncer with a length ball outside off, nipping in substantially. Khan pushes at it and is beaten all ends up. The ball just misses the off pole. A wicket and a run from the over.
Greets Khan with a sharp bouncer on off. He sways away to evade it.
Shadab Khan strides out to bat.

OUT! This has become a procession now for the visitors! The trend to lose wickets continues. Good length delivery outside off, skids after pitching. Malik throws his bat at it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball travels at a fast pace towards Taylor at first slip. He gets his hands to it but the ball pops out. Has the alertness to keep his eyes on it and takes it nicely before tumbling down. Taylor has been sharp as a hawk in the slip region today. He plucks his third catch of the game.
Good length ball around off, pushed off the front foot towards covers. Wants a run but is rightly sent back by his skipper.
On a length outside off, played with an open bat face to point.
Back of a length ball on middle, worked around the corner for a run.
Short of a length on middle, punched off the back foot to the off side for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fullish ball, defended off the front foot to mid on.
Good length ball, kept out watchfully.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Sarfraz Ahmed comes out to bat. A captain's knock is the need of the hour. Can he bail his side out of trouble?

OUT! New Zealand continue to dominate the proceedings! They have kept the pressure on Pakistan and are reaping the dividends as a result. Back of a length ball outside off, Azam places it through point and takes off. They run hard between the wickets and Babar calls Malik through for the second run. It is risky as Santner has got a good arm. Fires in a flat and accurate throw to the keeper as Azam tries to rush back in. The bails are whipped off and it seems that the batsman is struggling. Munro has already taken off. Time for the replays. Well, Azam's bat got stuck on the ground and he fails to make it in. Brilliant piece of fielding. Pakistan keep on sloping downhill.
Most likely, New Zealand have got another one. They are already celebrating. Brilliant work from Santner which seems to have caught Azam short of his crease.
Ooh... tentative! Good length ball, shaping in appreciably. Azam looks to keep it out but gets an inside edge past the leg stump. A run taken.
Length delivery outside off, Azam covers the line and keeps it out.
Shaping in towards Azam who shuffles across and clips it to square leg.
Well-timed shot but Azam fails to pick up the gap again! Short and room on offer, Azam punches it sweetly but straight to the man at point.
Fuller in length, Babar comes forward and pushes it defensively to covers.
Length ball on off, nipping in. Azam hangs back and defends it stoutly.
Lockie Ferguson comes into the attack.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed neatly towards short third man. Malik wants a run but is rightly sent back. The pressure continues to be on the visitors, only 2 from it.
Overpitched around off, driven sweetly through mid on for a single.
Good length ball outside off, placed past point to rotate strike. Pakistan need to do this on a consistent basis if they are to stay in the game.
Angling in substantially, tucked with a closed bat face to mid-wicket. Three dots in a row.
Fuller in length around off, pushed off the front foot back to the bowler.
Starts off with a shortish delivery outside off, Malik cuts it but finds the point fielder.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle. Also, the first change as Colin Munro comes into the attack. Latham is standing up to the stumps.
Good running! Good length delivery on middle and off, Shoaib taps besides the pitch. Azam calls for the single and they complete it easily in the end. End of the Powerplay, Pakistan 9/3.
Goes fuller again, trying out the sucker ball. Blocked firmly off the front foot towards cover.
Bowls a well-directed bouncer on middle and leg, Malik realizes it early and quickly sways away from the fire line. Good take from Latham too.
Pitches it right up there, Malik leans forward and defends it with his bat and pad close together.
Ahead of a length on middle and off, defended off the front foot to the cover fielder.
This one shapes away a bit too much to make Malik fall for the bait.
This one stayed a bit low. Fuller in length and on the stumps, Babar Azam blocks it out back on the pitch. Maiden again. I am out of superlatives to describe the opening spells from the Kiwi pacers.
Pushes this fuller ball towards the man at mid on.
Brings it back into the batsman who is up to the task.. Babar shuffles a touch and defends it towards short mid-wicket.
Walks across the sticks to another full ball and shows a solid front foot defense.
Once again Azam walks across the sticks to negotiate to inswing and keeps it out.
Fuller ball, curling back in a touch, defended firmly off the front foot.
Touch short and outside off, placed square of the wicket on the off side for a single. Another over with just 1 run off it.
BA has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Beaten! Good length delivery, angling away again. Azam swivels to pull but the ball skids off the deck and sneaks under his bat to the keeper. The runs have dried up completely and you can sense the pressure when Azam played this kind of shot.
He's mixing it up really well! Now bangs in a short one, climbing off the deck, Azam arches back to evade it.
Bowls a cross-seam delivery on middle and leg, wristed towards short mid-wicket.
Slants it away on a good length outside off, Babar Azam doesn't fiddle with it.
Drags his length on the shorter side, Malik rises on his toes to defend it back to the bowler. A maiden for Southee. Impressive from the Kiwi quicks.
Changes the pace and delivers it fuller outside off, dabbed away towards the point fielder.
Malik defends it from within the crease.
This one straightens just a touch from a good length area, it's defended towards point.
Fuller and nipping back in from outside off, Malik comes froward and with his bat and pad together he pushes it towards mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, SM looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards point.
Very full outside off, sliced off the outer half to third man for a single. Another spectacular over from Boult, just 1 off it.
Angles it again wider outside off, this time the batsman resists.

This isn't impressive from Malik! Boult dishes out a fuller delivery, very wide outside off, asking Malik to go after it. Shoaib obliges as he leans with a stride forward to go after it only to get beaten. Not a good shot to go after when the ball is moving.
Back of a length, kicking off the deck, Malik hops and fends it towards point in an awkward manner.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length delivery, angling across, Shoaib Malik leaves it alone.
FOUR! First one of the innings and that should get Azam going! Southee errs in line and drifts one on the pads, Babar flicks it through backward square leg to get off the mark.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Azam rises on the toes to defend.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good stop from Santner! Good length delivery outside off, punched hard but Santner at cover moves quickly to his right to make a stop. NZ giving nothing away.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Fuller and angling in from outside off, Azam shoulders his arms.
Keeps it on a length and this one skids to ping Malik on the pads. Pitching outside leg, maybe! Anyway, A DOUBLE WICKET MAIDEN for Boult.
One experienced player is replaced by another as Shoaib Malik strides in next.

OUT! Pakistan have been Boult-ed here! Terrific, absolutely terrific from Trent! He is up and running. A dream start for the Kiwis! He once again steams in and pitches it on a length around middle and off. This one shapes away with some nice zip off the surface. Hafeez can't get away from it. Has a tentative poke at it only to edge it behind to Ross Taylor who catches another one at first slip. Almost a replica of Azhar Ali's wicket. Pakistan in tatters!
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump. Tight stuff from Trent!
On a length and this one curls back in from outside off, Hafeez shoulders his arms.
Good length delivery, angling away, Hafeez rides the bounce and pushes it to cover.
The Professor, Mohammad Hafeez walks in next. He stroked a classy fifty in the previous game. He has a job to do again. Will he make his experience count?

OUT! Chops it on this time! The reason why I have written this time is because he got off the mark in a similar fashion. Then it evaded the stumps but not this time. Pakistan lose both their openers and have been rocked early. Back of a length delivery, just outside the off stump line. Fakhar Zaman stands tall to cut this but maybe, the slowness on the surface gets the better of him. He ends up dragging it back on the stumps.
Straight to the man! Fuller and served wider outside off, Babar Azam leans ahead and drives it off the meat but fails to pierce the gap.
Angles it in on middle and leg, defended with a solid bat towards mid-wicket.
Reads the slower full ball and then wrists it wide of the man at mid on for a single.
Covers the line to this length delivery and defends it safely back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller and veering on the pads, whipped on the bounce to short mid-wicket.
Babar Azam is the next man in.

OUT! Induced an edge and Azhar Ali walks back for a duck! Brilliant delivery from Boult, this. He lands it on a length on middle and off. This one kicks off the deck with some appreciable away movement. Ali is put into a tangle as he gets squared up completely. Looks to poke at it and it takes the outside edge towards first slip where Ross Taylor takes an excellent catch. New Zealand draw first blood. So, Santner will be a relieved man as the dropped chance hasn't cost anything.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

In the air... spilled! Santner gives a reprieve to Ali. Fuller and sprayed wider outside off, Ali leans ahead and goes for an expansive drive. Plays it uppishly and it travels quickly to Santner at extra cover who dives to take it but the ball doesn't stick.
Length delivery on middle and leg, clipped towards square leg.

Nearly chops it on! On the back of a length, just outside off, Fakhar Zaman looks to force it through the off side but gets a thick inside edge which just bounces over the leg stump. Latham dives to his right and gets some glove on it. Pakistan take a single to get going.
Boult angles it in on middle and leg from over the wicket, Zaman moves inside the line to whip it away but there is a tinge of inward movement and as a result, he wears this one on the pads.
Trent Boult to operate from the other end with the second new ball. Two slips for him.
Once again delivers in the corridor of uncertainty, double A has got nothing to do with it. A tidy start for Southee, a maiden to begin with.
Good probing line from Tim. In the channel outside off, Azhar plants his front foot across to make back-to-back leaves.
Southee goes wider of the crease and lands it on a back of a length outside off. It curls back in but Ali has it covered as he makes a watchful leave.
Good length delivery, angling in from outside off, punched nicely off the back foot towards mid off.
Fuller and arrowing in on off, Ali taps it towards point off the front foot.
Starts off with a back of a length delivery from over the wicket, Azhar Ali gets behind the line and punches it off the back foot to mid on.

We are back for the run chase. Is 257 enough? New Zealand will love to believe in the affirmative. Pakistan's batting has to come to the fore today if they are to keep the series alive. Out walk the two openers - Azhar Ali and Fakhar Zaman. Tim Southee to kickoff proceedings for the hosts. A slip for him. Here we go...
